FN-ILUXSWYW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 55
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 55 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines, and increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of citations issued to non resident undocumented
immigrants driving in Alabama without a valid driver license, pursuant to the provisions of this
bill.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama State Law
Enforcement Agency to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-ILUXSWYW-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 55
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/28/2025
Senate Bill 55 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the State General Fund and
municipal general funds from fines, and increase receipts to the State General Fund, county
general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of citations issued to non resident
undocumented immigrants driving in Alabama without a valid driver license, pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama State Law
Enforcement Agency and the Alabama Department of Transportation to comply with the
provisions of this bill.
